name: ga4gh-refget skill
summary: Fetch checksum, length, and alias metadata, bounded raw sequence bytes, and sequence-collection facts from a GA4GH refget-conformant server
description: Bundled Claude Code / MCP skill for GA4GH refget, shipped alongside the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-ga4gh-refget` Cordis plugin and standalone MCP server in the `ga4gh-plugins` monorepo. Fetch checksum, length, and alias metadata, bounded raw sequence bytes, and sequence-collection facts from a GA4GH refget-conformant server. Use when the user asks to look up or verify a sequence identifier (a ga4gh:SQ.* checksum or accession) against a refget server, asks about a sequence's GA4GH (SQ.*) or MD5 checksum, length, or known aliases, wants a bounded byte range of raw sequence content, or asks about a genome assembly / sequence collection by its seqcol digest.
